necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Given the history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9), mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other significant arrhythmias. This service was denied under Reason Code CO-197 due to missing prior authorization, but the clinical indication confirms the medical necessity of the procedure.
